list: Every one of the 55 official PlayStation 5 trophies — 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, 27 of them visible and 28 hidden until earned. Names and descriptions are printed exactly as PlayStation Network publishes them (Exophase list, read 18 Nov 2026, cross-checked against PSNProfiles and TrueTrophies). The guidance underneath each one is written fresh for this guide and names the source its facts come from.
notes: The whole set is single-player and offline — there is not one online trophy in it. Cheats switch trophies and saving off, so leave them alone for the entire run. Missions cannot be replayed, which is why this guide asks you to keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; the game gives you 15 manual save slots. A single trophy is flagged as possibly missable (Positive Mental Attitude), and three more have no published unlock method yet (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin) — for those three this guide tells you plainly that the method is unknown instead of inventing one.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (PSN, as reported by Push Square / GTABase)
GGRecon — GTA 6’s trophy list is out, and the Platinum needs 100%

difficultyNote: The difficulty number (1–5) and the time next to each trophy are this guide's own planning estimates, not official figures. The three trophies with no confirmed method carry no difficulty number at all.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is nothing extra to do for this one: it appears by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Budget roughly 200 hours for the whole set, and remember the single step that cannot be put off — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, the only trophy in the set that can slip away.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum has no task of its own.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one step that can be missed.
Play through the chapter route in this guide for the order that wastes the least time.
tips: Track your count on the checklist here — the platinum pops the instant the last box is ticked.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; there is no mission replay to fall back on.
route: Last step of the run: it lands automatically once the other 54 are done.

steps: Play Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1.
Finish the mission — the trophy unlocks by itself.
tips: Nothing to prepare: it is the first story trophy you will earn.
route: First mission of Chapter 1 — it cannot be skipped past.

Start Chapter 4 and finish Ocean Beach and Another Life — the trophy pops then.
tips: Chapter 3 opens several questlines (Andy, Randy, Tyrone) — start them as they appear so they do not pile up.

steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's missions.
The trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.

Complete it — finishing the story earns the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion and this gold trophy is yours. The checklist itself opens after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and anything you did during the story already counts toward it. It sounds worse than it is: PowerPyx puts the list near 60% of true completion, because most side quests are not needed and most counts are only partly required — scan any 200 of 277 vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals, do any 70 of 80 challenges. Only five areas need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the list can be missed, and all of it can be done in free-roam after the credits. This is the hardest trophy in the set, so expect most of your playtime to go here.
steps: Finish the story first — progress made during it already counts toward 100%.
Open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion and work the checklist: any 70 of 80 challenges, any 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts.
Finish the parts that need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
Nothing toward 100% is missable — it is all doable in free-roam after the story.
tips: Scan vehicles and study animals whenever you see them during the story — that progress is already banked.
Use the 100% table in this guide for the exact counts; the rows that say 'all' are the only ones that need everything.
route: Stage 2 of the platinum path, after the story — the longest grind in the set.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the game's 397 stunts. Four kinds count — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them however you like; threading a plane under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up. Your progress lives under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and the map marks stunt spots under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this one pops on the way there.
steps: Find stunts on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
Mix the four kinds freely — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps; flying under bridges is the quickest.
Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.
tips: Under-the-bridge runs in a fast plane rack up stunts far faster than jumps.
Do this alongside the 100% checklist — never as a separate grind.
route: Stage 2, folded into the 100% checklist work.
trophies.when: After the story, with the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Progress, Activities shows which ones you have tried. Most of them turn up naturally while you chase the other trophies, so leave this one alone early and let it fill itself in.
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, a stunt.
Check Progress, Activities to see which you have done.
Most come up naturally — do not chase this one early.
tips: A single stunt counts — do one early and forget about it.
Golf and pool are the easiest to tick off deliberately if they are the last ones left.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — mostly fills itself in during the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in every shooting range challenge — 12 ranges holding 42 challenges between them. The challenges themselves are not especially hard, and the hours at the ranges also lift your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier later.
steps: Visit the 12 shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in every challenge — 42 golds in total.
Working on them also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
tips: Steady aim beats fast trigger work — take the extra second to line each shot up.
Ranges also feed the 100% checklist, which needs all 12 gold-medalled.
route: Stage 2, part of the 100% checklist — all 12 ranges must be gold.
trophies.when: After the story, with the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races exist in total, but a single win at each location is all the trophy asks for.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total.
You only need one win per location, not every race.
tips: Learn one location's course properly instead of spreading attempts across all of them.
The 100% checklist needs every drone race done, so wins here are not wasted.
route: Stage 2, part of the 100% checklist.
trophies.when: After the story, with the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Forty unique race locations exist, so there is no need to win the hard ones — pick the twenty easiest and skip the rest.
steps: Win 20 different races out of 40 unique race locations.
Pick the easiest ones and skip the rest.
tips: Short, flat circuits in a fast car are the quickest wins.
A race win also counts toward Master of None's activity types.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — pick the easy races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet him in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; after that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, follow Cal's texts to the marked fishing spot.
Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.
tips: Fishing also counts as one of Master of None's nine activity types.
The questline is marked for you — just follow the purple icons.
route: Starts in Chapter 1; finish whenever you like after that.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through. Four games are on offer — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home with the controllers, and you can start them from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck lives on arcade machines around the world. Clear every level of whichever one you pick — beating every challenge inside it is not required.
steps: Pick one of the four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (on the TV at home) or Bang For Your Buck (arcade machines).
Finish all the levels of that one game — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.
tips: The home TV games are the simplest to reach — start there.
Playing a video game also ticks one of Master of None's nine activity types.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — available from Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: See Andy's questline through to its last mission. It is Lucia-only and opens by itself in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Five quests make up the line — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests remain available after the story ends.
steps: Wait for Andy's call in Chapter 3 — her questline is Lucia-only and marked automatically.
Finish all five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The trophy pops after the last one; the quests stay available after the story.
tips: Play as Lucia whenever Andy's icon is up — the line is hers alone.
The quests stay open in free-roam, so there is no rush.
route: Chapter 3 questline, Lucia-only.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It opens by itself in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — sweep the wrecks with the metal detector, find the chests and bring them back to him. Kenton disappears for a while after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds his return), and everything stays available after the story. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
steps: After the mission Island Dreams in Chapter 1, follow Kenton's green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back.
Kenton goes away temporarily after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3; everything stays available after the story.
tips: Diving also feeds the 100% checklist's underwater discoveries.
If Kenton has vanished, play on as Jason and call Brian to hurry his return.
route: Chapter 1 questline; finish across Chapters 1–3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It opens by itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests make up the line — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and all of them stay available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Finish all five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
tips: The quests stay open in free-roam, so there is no rush.
route: Chapter 2 questline, from the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every side questline counts toward it — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Strands that are confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy list itself shows your running count.
steps: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Confirmed strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward it.
Strangers stay available in free-roam; the trophy list shows your count.
tips: Do not waste time on the six questlines that do not count — they have their own trophies.
Check the trophy list's counter before hunting for the last strand.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — strangers stay open in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. His list, Randy's Wish List, opens by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon): scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back — a car in good condition pays more. Follow the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's list to his garage in west Vice City.
Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list; a car in good condition pays more.
tips: Scan before you steal — only list cars count.
Bring cars back undamaged; condition affects the payout.
route: Chapter 3 questline; deliveries can wait until free-roam.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline. It is Jason-only and opens by itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in purple around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest), and once enough labs are down Tyrone gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down for good. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, follow Tyrone's purple-marked Synthetic Labs around Vice City.
Destroy enough labs (Take Out Kitty Litter) and Tyrone gives you Spin On This.
Shut the labs down for good — everything stays available after the story.
tips: Play as Jason whenever Tyrone's icons are up — the line is his alone.
The labs stay open in free-roam, so there is no rush.
route: Chapter 3 questline, Jason-only.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations. You can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location. Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation is not marked as a spot at all. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you can accept and learn to meditate there. It is permanently gone after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — PowerPyx did it and earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
steps: FIRST — Chapter 1, right after the mission Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation. It is gone for good after Chapter 1.
Then meditate at the 18 spots at 10 locations — you can meditate as both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2.
Track it under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
tips: Do the balcony step before anything else in Chapter 1 — it is the only missable step in the whole game.
Meditate as both characters at every spot to double your count per location.
route: START HERE: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, before the chapter ends.
Then the 18 marked spots, finishing after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.when: Chapter 1 — do the balcony step first

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). It is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy, but finishing his questline is the way there. It stays available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, follow Bret's texts — his questline is Jason-only.
Hunt the animals he requests at the purple-marked spots and bring them to him.
He gives you the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest.
Finishing his questline is the way there; it stays available after the story.
tips: The Killtelligence SM-69 is retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker if you lose it.
Bret's quests are also one of the five 'all' rows of the 100% checklist.
route: Chapter 2 questline, Jason-only.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida — pick any three sets and finish them.
steps: Find the 18 card set locations across Leonida.
Pick any three sets and complete them.
tips: Choose the three sets nearest to places you already travel through.
Card sets are a collectible, not a 100% checklist item — do them on their own time.
route: Stage 2 collectibles — any three sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up then R1 to scan objects in the world — landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do.
steps: Hold Up then R1 to scan objects: landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags.
Any 100 will do — there are more than 100 in total.
tips: Scan everything you walk past during the story — the count builds itself.
City landmarks are the densest cluster; a slow walk through Vice City covers dozens.
route: Stage 2 collectibles — scan as you play.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges and you need any 50; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops on the way. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones left.
steps: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges — track them under Progress, Challenges.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way.
Most complete naturally; leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones left.
tips: Never chase challenges early — let them accumulate passively.
When only a few are left, sort by the ones closest to done.
route: Stage 2, folded into the 100% checklist work.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. It needs partner free-roam, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape in a fast sports bike; the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. An easy route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. You will also likely get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since large bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
steps: Unlock partner free-roam after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with Right + Triangle.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape in a fast sports bike until you drive out of the red heat zone.
Try the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow.
tips: A fast sports bike is the whole trick — outrun the zone instead of fighting in it.
Bank vault robberies in Chapter 4 trigger 4 stars by themselves, so this may pop on its own.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — needs partner free-roam from Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. It also needs partner free-roam from Chapter 2 (Coffee Break). Hit three robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a few items in each, ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop.
steps: Bring a partner (unlocked after Coffee Break) and an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items.
Rob three shops back-to-back while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level.
Try the three jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3).
The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
tips: Do not let the wanted level drop between shops — that breaks the chain.
Break the back-room safe with sticky bombs for the best loot per shop.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — needs the Chapter 3 jewelry stores.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up for instant use) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this comes automatically. Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by.
Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them.
Check totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
tips: A busy road does the work for you — stand still and scan the traffic.
This is pure progress toward the 100% checklist's 200 scanned vehicles.
route: Stage 2, folded into the 100% checklist work.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle) to stretch the window. Line up five enemies at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets easier as you level up.
steps: Buff Focus first with food, drinks or a wash/shower at home, and use Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle) to stretch the window.
Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming, then take down 5 enemies in the one use.
Line up five enemies at a gang operation with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556.
Raise Focus via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — it gets easier as you level up.
tips: A gang operation gives you five enemies standing close together — that is the setup.
Do not waste attempts on police, soldiers or civilians; they do not seem to count.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — easier once Focus is levelled up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
steps: Drive through a fence around the VCIA airfield to terminals E3/E4.
Take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge.
Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy pops (slightly delayed).
tips: Only a plane hooked to a boarding bridge counts — ignore the ones parked on the airfield.
Reverse carefully to the strip before opening the throttle.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — VCIA, terminals E3/E4.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — they stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
Climb into a tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies until it pops.
tips: The stunt jump by the south-east entrance is the faster way in.
Once inside the tank, the base's own defences do the work for you.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door (which sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. A good target is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and mark jewelry store robberies.
Enter through the back door and use the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door.
Find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
tips: Kicking the door trips the alarm — the Snap Gun is the whole trick.
Read the safe-code note before you touch the safe.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — needs Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which introduces bank vaults: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — hold Right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his earlier Payday Loans quests) and follow the purple van icons. Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe) to learn bank vaults.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag.
After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips and follow the purple van icons.
Escape on a fast motorcycle — each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
tips: Always bring your partner — one person cannot carry all the cash.
Switch vehicles mid-escape; the heat follows the bike, not you.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — needs the Chapter 4 vault introduction.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) counts a vault robbery as an armored truck robbery, so it pops there automatically. You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
steps: It pops during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, which counts a vault robbery as an armored truck robbery.
Or earlier: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and escape the red heat radius.
tips: The easiest path is to let the Chapter 4 mission do it for you.
Sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — automatic with the vault mission.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible.
steps: Fully unfog the whole map — fly over every black-fogged area.
The fastest way is by plane.
tips: A plane covers in minutes what a car takes hours to do.
Sweep the coast and the islands last — they are the easiest to overlook.
route: Stage 2, folded into the 100% checklist work.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs.
steps: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations in total.
Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them; many are marked automatically by story progress.
Track each gang under Progress, Gangs.
tips: One operation per gang is enough for the trophy — the other 30 are only for 100%.
Yellow icons appear as you drive near them, so they surface during normal play.
route: Stage 2, folded into the 100% checklist work.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No reliable method has been published yet — PowerPyx still lists this trophy as unknown. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach is the obvious place to try, but the exact bar, time or trigger has not been pinned down by any source I could find. Do not trust a specific method until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you are out on the street. Only the blue Banshee counts — it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: First get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — only the blue one counts.
Drive it straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you are out on the street.
tips: Any other colour does not count — check the paint before you drive.
Aim straight at the glass and keep the throttle down.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs — buy them at Ammu-Nation first). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and you do not need all three in one visit — the robbery icon respawns after a long while, so you can come back for whatever you missed.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations — you go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Steal all three valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east corner table) and the safe (north-east hallway office, blow it with sticky bombs).
The trophy pops after you escape the police — you do not need all three in one visit.
tips: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation before you go — the safe needs them.
If you miss one valuable, come back later; the robbery icon respawns.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always train together (call your partner with Right + Triangle); while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, select a character, Strength (heart icon). Fitness clubs are on the map under Activities (dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters.
Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — while one works out, the other trains automatically.
Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, select a character, Strength (heart icon).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Your profile shifts through Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — the last one is permanent, so do not push that far. It happens passively while you work on the other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts.

Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies and enemy encounters count.
It happens passively while you work on the other trophies; do not push as far as Irredeemable — it is permanent.
tips: Watch for the small demon face on the right of the screen — that is an action counting.
Stop well short of Irredeemable; it cannot be undone.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it, and it drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed.
steps: Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone.
Look for a blinking car parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears.
Follow the path from the car into the woods and approach the UFO.
Talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.
tips: Go alone and after 2AM — the timing matters.
If the car is not there, leave the area and return; the spawn is random.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…) can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

Rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip.
tips: Yasmani pays the best rate — take your bills to him.
Vaults pay up to $205,000 in one hit, so this fills fast in Chapter 4.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it — Ammu-Nation, mod shops and tattoo studios are the most expensive. Every shop type counts: clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, electronics, Pay 'n' Sprays and more.
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way.
Every shop type counts: clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, electronics, Pay 'n' Sprays and more.
tips: Buy the expensive stuff first — a full car mod or a top-tier gun eats the total quickly.
Money from vault robberies covers this without any extra grinding.
route: Stage 3 cleanup — spend as you earn.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to raise the cash.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 in total.
Robberies, especially in Chapters 3–4, are the quickest way to raise the cash.
tips: Only the 8 purchasable garages count — the 4 story garages do not.
Each garage adds parking spots, which On the Spot needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register.
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes — registering costs money; at first he only accepts vehicles without trackers.
tips: Buy the garages first — without parking space you cannot register anything.
Cheap cars and bikes keep the registration fees low.

path.title: Before Chapter 1 ends — the one missable step
path.detail: Do the balcony meditation right after Down to Earth, then keep scanning vehicles and studying animals as you play — that progress is already banked toward 100%.

path.title: Play the story — Chapters 1–5
path.detail: All 19 story trophies unlock as you go. None of them can be missed, so just play the missions as they come.

path.title: Character questlines as they open
path.detail: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — start each line when it appears and finish it in free-roam if you like; all of them stay available after the story.

path.title: Work the 100% checklist
path.detail: Challenges, vehicles, animals and stunts, plus everything in the 100% table above — the longest stretch of the run.

path.title: Collectibles
path.detail: Meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans, garages and vehicle registrations — sweep these up between the bigger jobs.

path.title: Cleanup — activities, money and odd jobs
path.detail: Races, fishing, arcade games, Strangers & Freaks, wanted-level and robbery trophies, easter eggs — the free-roam mop-up.

path.title: The three unknowns
path.detail: In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin have no confirmed method yet — check a cited guide before planning around them.

path.title: Platinum pops
path.detail: Vice Got a Price! unlocks automatically once the other 54 are earned.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — Vice City opens
chapters.focus: Play the opening missions, and do the balcony meditation before the chapter ends.
chapters.advice: Chapter 1 is short, but it holds the single step in the whole game that cannot be redone. Right after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her out to the balcony to learn meditation — after Chapter 1 that moment is gone for good. Apart from that, play the missions as they come, scan every vehicle you pass and study every animal you see; both counts feed the 100% checklist later. Kenton's diving line opens here too, after Island Dreams.
chapters.saveNote: Make a manual save at the start of the chapter — 15 manual slots, and no mission replay.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Two characters, one map
chapters.focus: Partner free-roam opens after Coffee Break — most of the game's systems unlock here.
chapters.advice: Coffee Break is the chapter's hinge: after it you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together, which several trophies need. Billy's questline opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, Bret's hunting line starts with a text, and the garage shop opens after Daily Driver. This is also the chapter to start training strength together and scanning vehicles on every drive.
chapters.saveNote: Manual save at the chapter start; keep the Chapter 1 save untouched.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Vice City proper
chapters.focus: Questlines pile up here — Andy, Randy and Tyrone all open in this chapter.
chapters.advice: Chapter 3 is the busiest for side content: Andy's Lucia-only line, Randy's 16-car wish list, Tyrone's lab hunt, plus the Key Cloner, the Dye Pack Jammer and Yasmani's jewelry jobs. None of it can be missed, so work through it at your own pace, but start each line when it appears so the map does not fill up. The Cartel Heist is the chapter's story trophy.
chapters.saveNote: Manual save at the chapter start.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 — Heists and vaults
chapters.focus: Bank vaults open here and change how money works for the rest of the run.
chapters.advice: The optional mission That's Where The Money Is… teaches bank vaults — do it when it appears, because vaults pay up to $205,000 a hit and feed the laundering trophy, the spending trophy and the garage fund. Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown are the chapter's story trophies, and the final mission Starting From Zero ends the story. After the credits, the whole map is yours for cleanup.
chapters.saveNote: Manual save at the chapter start — and one more right before the final mission.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 — The last mission, then free-roam
chapters.focus: One story mission, then the 100% checklist and cleanup begin.
chapters.advice: Chapter 5 is a single mission, Operation Savage Glory. Once it is done the story is over and the checklist under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion opens. From here on, work the 100% table in this guide, then the collectibles, then the cleanup trophies — in that order, so nothing is done twice.
chapters.saveNote: Keep the pre-finale save; it is your last clean checkpoint before free-roam.

budget.note: All 19 story trophies plus the questlines that open along the way.
Challenges, vehicles, animals, stunts, ranges, drone races, vaults, underwater finds, Bret's quests.
Meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans, garages, vehicle registrations.
Races, fishing, arcade games, Strangers & Freaks, robbery and wanted-level trophies.
The UFO easter egg, the tank, the plane, the showroom smash.
One playthrough, no online trophies, no mission medals. Hours are this guide's own estimates.

stageGuides.title: Stage 1 — Play the story
stageGuides.lede: Finish all 5 chapters and the story trophies unlock as you go — none of them can be missed. Scan vehicles and study animals whenever you see them; that progress already counts toward 100%.

stageGuides.title: Stage 2 — 100% completion
stageGuides.lede: The checklist opens under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion. You need any 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied and 300 stunts; only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.

stageGuides.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & cleanup
stageGuides.lede: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the remaining questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), the money trophies and any collectibles left — meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans, garages and vehicle registrations.

stageGuides.title: Stage 4 — Platinum
stageGuides.lede: When the other 54 trophies are earned, the platinum pops automatically. Before you celebrate: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay — and never turn on a cheat, because cheats disable trophies and saving.
